Projects.subtitle: Some of the projects I've worked on — web, mobile and full stack.

canchify.description: A marketplace platform for managing and booking sports courts in Colombia (soccer 5/6/7/8/11 and padel). It centralizes availability, bookings, and payments to assist clubs, replacing WhatsApp and Excel with a digital scheduling system, MercadoPago integration, and comprehensive operational management.

nodify.description: A desktop app (Tauri v2 + Rust + React) that unifies the configuration of coding AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Kilo Code, and Pi) into a single dashboard. It manages MCPs, skills, models, rules, and API keys, translating between native formats (JSON/TOML/JSONC) and synchronizing across devices via Git.
